chapter.heading: Job 25
Bildad Speaks: Man Cannot Be Righteous
chapter.v:
Then Bildad
the Shuhite,
answered and said:

“Dominion and
fear are,
with God;(1) he makes peace in his high heaven.

Is there
any number,
to his armies? Upon whom does his light not arise?

How then
can man,
be in the right before God? How can he who is born of woman be pure?

how much
less man,,
who is a maggot, and the son of man, who is a worm!” Footnotes (1) 25:2 Hebrew *him* (ESV)
